Hi again
Just among us now, letting you know that, on the other hand, they have formally partnered with Greg Kehailia in our
media project.
See summary write up below. Fyi
Joey
USAID partners with Facebook to combat misinformation and disinformation. With the upcoming May 2022
election, it is expected that there will be an onslaught of disinformation and smear campaigns in popular social media
platforms. On July 15, USAID, through its Initiative for Media Freedom (IMF) project, signed a partnership agreement
with Facebook to support the training of additional fact checkers in the Philippines. Selected organizations will
participate in the fact-checking incubator activity organized by IMF and are expected to seek and obtain accreditation
from the International Fact Checking Network. So what? The partnership between USAID and Facebook to double
the number of accredited fact checkers in the Philippines advances USAID's private sector engagement initiative in
the DRG sector. More importantly, the partnership will help prevent the spread of false information and help citizens
make informed decisions.
